tweet.text: We’ve started to measure time horizons for recent models using our updated methodology. On this expanded suite of software tasks, we estimate that Gemini 3 Pro has a 50%-time-horizon of around 4 hrs (95% CI of 2 hr 10 mins to 7 hrs 20 mins).
